title: 第23章 沈砚秋第24章 紧张的沈朗
slug: 乱世荒年我每日一卦粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第23章沈砚秋
“二郎，莫要冲动！”
这时，陈巧翠追了出来！
看到江尘气势汹汹的出去，她瞬间就急了。
江尘性子才稍有改变，要是再闹出事情来可就麻烦了。
可刚出门，就见江尘和对面的女孩面面相觑，相距不过三步。
“咋回事这是？”
她还以为是谁来找麻烦，也是一头雾水。
江尘开口解释：“我以为是那泼皮找麻烦，没想到……”
说完看向对面的少女，“敢问姑娘芳名？”
少女脸又红了：“沈砚秋。”
江尘低声喃喃。
：“秋夜临砚，研墨作诗，好名字啊！”
这名字，起码比什么大花、二花好听得多。
沈砚秋听到这解释，不由眼前一亮。
这三山村绝大多数人都目不识丁，没想到传言中的“泼皮”
还能说出这种话来。
看来传言也不能全信。
可这么直白的夸赞，不由让她脸再次红到了耳根。
旁边的陈巧翠嘴角却挂上莫名的笑意：“二郎这是城里去多了？说话跟戏台上似的。”

江尘才回过神——这不是古装剧，他也不是身穿白衣的翩翩公子。
实在是面前的女子和这乡下地方的画风有些不搭，让他一时反应不及。
陈巧翠转头看向沈砚秋：“沈家丫头啊，你这大早上来，是有什么事儿吗？”
沈砚秋这也从方才的怔忪中回过神，开口道：“我听说昨天……”
说到一半，目光瞟向江尘，嗯嗯了两声，似是叫了江尘的名字，“……抓了一条鱼。”
“我爹爹最近生病，想换些鱼肉炖汤，给他补补身子。”
说完将手中布包举高:“这是两斤粟米，能换点鱼尾巴附近的肉就行。”
“原来是换鱼肉啊。”
陈巧翠笑了，“可鱼尾巴哪有多少肉，还全是刺……正好我才把把鱼头剁了下来，炖汤最适合不过。”
“马上给你拿来。”
本有些紧张的沈砚秋神色一喜，可紧接着又带着些局促：“多谢婶子，我家粟米不多了，给钱可以吗？”
说着就往怀里掏。
“嗨。”
陈巧翠一脸不在意，“一个村的，计较这些干啥。”
“来，进屋来，我给你拿。”
陈巧翠招手示意沈砚秋跟上。
沈砚秋挪动脚步，在江尘身边绕了个圈，远远地跟着进了院子。
江尘不由摸了摸鼻子：“我有这么可怕吗？”
随之也跟着进去，见陈巧翠正和沈砚秋说话，便顺手回房关了门。
没再去管外边的事，闭目打开了龟甲。
content_en:
Chapter 23 Shen Yanqiu
"Erlang, don't be impulsive!"
At this time, Chen Qiaocui chased him out!
When she saw Jiang Chen going out in a menacing manner, she immediately became anxious.
Jiang Chen's temperament has just changed slightly, and it will be troublesome if he causes trouble again.
But as soon as he went out, he saw Jiang Chen and the girl opposite looking at each other, only three steps apart.
"What's going on?"
She was also confused as to who was causing trouble.
Jiang Chen opened his mouth to explain: "I thought it was the rogue looking for trouble, but I didn't expect..."
After speaking, he looked at the girl opposite and said, "Dare you ask her her name?"
The girl's face turned red again: "Shen Yanqiu."
Jiang Chen murmured in a low voice.
: "Lying with the inkstone on an autumn night, studying ink and composing poems, what a good name!"
This name is at least much nicer than the big flower or the second flower.
When Shen Yanqiu heard this explanation, his eyes lit up.
The vast majority of people in this Sanshan Village are illiterate, and they did not expect the rumored "rascal"
You can still say something like this.
It seems that the rumors cannot be believed.
But such a straightforward compliment made her blush all the way to her ears again.
Chen Qiaocui next to him had an inexplicable smile on his lips: "Has Erlang been in the city too much? He talks like he is on the stage."
Only then did Jiang Chen come back to his senses - this was not a costume drama, and he was not a handsome young man in white.
In fact, the woman in front of him didn't match the style of this rural place, so he couldn't react in time.
Chen Qiaocui turned to look at Shen Yanqiu: "Girl of the Shen family, what's the matter with you coming here so early in the morning?"
Shen Yanqiu also recovered from the shock just now and said, "I heard yesterday..."
Halfway through, he glanced at Jiang Chen, hummed twice, and seemed to call Jiang Chen's name, "...caught a fish."
"My father has been ill recently and I want to replace him with some fish stew to replenish his health."
After speaking, he raised the cloth bag in his hand and said, "This is two kilograms of corn. I can exchange it for some meat near the tail of the fish."
"It turns out it's for fish meat."
Chen Qiaocui smiled, "But the fish tail doesn't have much meat, it's still full of spines... I just chopped off the fish head. It's perfect for stewing soup."
"Bring it to you right away."
Shen Yanqiu, who was a little nervous at first, looked happy, but then he became a little embarrassed: "Thank you, Auntie, I don't have much corn at home, can I give you some money?"
As he said that, he took it into his arms.
"Hi."
Chen Qiaocui looked unconcerned and said, "If you're from a village, why do you care about this?"
"Come on, come in, I'll get it for you."
Chen Qiaocui waved to Shen Yanqiu to follow.
Shen Yanqiu moved his steps, circled around Jiang Chen, and followed him into the courtyard from a distance.
Jiang Chen couldn't help but touch his nose: "Am I so scary?"
Then he followed in and saw Chen Qiaocui talking to Shen Yanqiu, so he went back to his room and closed the door.
He didn't care about the things outside anymore, closed his eyes and opened the tortoise shell.
